## Motivation

`Runtime.async_generate` silently returns no output when `/generate` rejects a request with a JSON HTTP error. The client only processes SSE data, so a 400 response looks like a successful empty generation. `add_request` has the same behavior.

## Modifications

Check the HTTP status before consuming the stream. Add a CPU regression test using a local HTTP server, covering both methods and preserving text deltas and error events sent inside HTTP 200 streams.

## Accuracy Tests

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/lang/test_runtime_http_errors.py -v
pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure
```

All three tests pass on macOS arm64 with Python 3.12.7 and aiohttp 3.14.5. Against the unmodified base, the six HTTP 400/422/503 cases fail; both HTTP 200 behavior tests pass. The tests use the real HTTP client and server without import stubs or model loading. Pre-commit passes.

No model accuracy evaluation was run; model computation is unchanged. Linux CPU CI is pending.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable. This checks the response status once before reading streamed data.

- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). Not applicable to this client-side error check.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

+import asyncio
+import unittest
+from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import aiohttp
+from aiohttp import web
+from aiohttp.test_utils import TestServer
+
+from sglang.lang.backend.runtime_endpoint import Runtime
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+@asynccontextmanager
+async def runtime_server(handler):
+    app = web.Application()
+    app.router.add_post("/generate", handler)
+    async with TestServer(app) as server:
+        runtime = Runtime.__new__(Runtime)
+        runtime.pid = None
+        runtime.server_args = SimpleNamespace(skip_tokenizer_init=False)
+        runtime.generate_url = str(server.make_url("/generate"))
+        yield runtime
+
+
+class TestRuntimeHttpErrors(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_http_errors_are_not_empty_generations(self):
+        """Rejected streaming requests must raise with their HTTP status."""
+
+        async def check(status, generate):
+            async def handler(request):
+                body = await request.json()
+                if status == 503:
+                    return web.Response(status=status, text="Service unavailable")
+                return web.json_response({"error": body["text"]}, status=status)
+
+            async with runtime_server(handler) as runtime:
+                with self.assertRaises(aiohttp.ClientResponseError) as raised:
+                    async for _ in generate(runtime, "private prompt"):
+                        self.fail("HTTP error response yielded a generation")
+                self.assertEqual(raised.exception.status, status)
+                self.assertNotIn("private prompt", str(raised.exception))
+
+        for status in (400, 422, 503):
+            for method_name, generate in (
+                ("async_generate", Runtime.async_generate),
+                ("add_request", Runtime.add_request),
+            ):
+                with self.subTest(status=status, method=method_name):
+                    asyncio.run(check(status, generate))
+
+    def test_successful_stream_preserves_text_deltas(self):
+        async def check():
+            async def handler(request):
+                response = web.StreamResponse(
+                    headers={"Content-Type": "text/event-stream"}
+                )
+                await response.prepare(request)
+                await response.write(b'data: {"text": "hello"}\n\n')
+                await response.write(b'data: {"text": "hello world"}\n\n')
+                await response.write(b"data: [DONE]\n\n")
+                return response
+
+            async with runtime_server(handler) as runtime:
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    [part async for part in runtime.async_generate("prompt")],
+                    ["hello", " world"],
+                )
+
+        asyncio.run(check())
+
+    def test_successful_response_preserves_error_events(self):
+        async def check():
+            async def handler(request):
+                response = web.StreamResponse(
+                    headers={"Content-Type": "text/event-stream"}
+                )
+                await response.prepare(request)
+                await response.write(
+                    b'data: {"error": {"message": "invalid input"}}\n\n'
+                )
+                await response.write(b"data: [DONE]\n\n")
+                return response
+
+            async with runtime_server(handler) as runtime:
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    [part async for part in runtime.async_generate("prompt")],
+                    [{"error": {"message": "invalid input"}}],
+                )
+
+        asyncio.run(check())
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
